recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring three female figures in silhouette, viewed from behind against a glowing red digital grid. The central figure is slightly forward, creating a triangular formation. The background features a technological interface aesthetic with glowing horizontal lines and data-like numeric strings.
coreVisualRelationships: Silhouetted figures against a high-luminance background
Triangular character arrangement for depth and hierarchy
Interaction between organic human forms and rigid geometric grid lines
Warm red-to-orange gradient providing a backlit halo effect

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures occupy the central vertical axis, scaled to fill approximately 80% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's back and the bright white logo at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top text, move down the silhouettes to the central hand gesture, and settle on the large title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense central subject matter with active 'cyber' negative space on the left and right margins.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black for the primary atmosphere and silhouettes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange-yellow for the halo lighting around the figures.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for primary typography and metallic silver for the logo.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; extreme value contrast between the black silhouettes and the glowing background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars extending from letters to create speed lines
Beveled 3D effect on the main title with a red inner glow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity through width; all fonts are extended sans-serifs varying only in weight and treatment.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the technical, wide-set aesthetic of early 2000s action media.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a digital background with a glowing red and orange gradient. Overlay a fine red perspective grid and faint vertical columns of random numbers. Place three female figures in silhouette, viewed from the back, wearing glossy black tactical gear. The central figure should have a bright orange rim-light halo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, 3D beveled metallic title at the bottom center with a red outer glow. Add wide-tracked, white, extended sans-serif text at the very top and just above the main title.

verificationChecks: Do the silhouettes have a distinct orange rim light?
Is the main title beveled and metallic?
Is the secondary text extremely wide-tracked?

adjustableVariables: Density of the background data numbers
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean silhouette edges against the glow.
Ensure the grid lines do not obscure the faces (if visible) or key gestures.
Verify that the metallic bevel on the text looks consistent with the lighting.
Confirm the 'Music From' text is centered and widely spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouetted trio + Cyber-grid background + Extended metallic sans-serif = Y2K Action Aesthetic.
